text.en:
of the Revised Penal Code be amended, as it is hereby amended,
so as to read as follows:
"Art. 114. Treason. - Any person who, owing allegiance
to the United States or the Government of the Philippine Islands,
not being a foreigner, levies war against them or adheres to
their enemies, giving them aid or comfort within the Philippine
Islands or elsewhere, shall be punished by reclusion temporal to
death, and shall pay a fine not to exceed 20,000 pesos.
No person shall be convicted of treason unless on the
testimony of two witnesses at least to the same overt act or on
confession of the accused in open court.
Likewise, any alien, residing in the Philippine Islands,
who commits acts of treason as defined in paragraph 1 of this
Article shall be punished by prison mayor to death and shall
pay a fine not to exceed 20,000 pesos".
Done in the City of Manila, Philippines, this 31& day of May, in the
year of Our Iord, 1945, and of the Commonwealth of the Philippines, the 10th.
_SERGIO OSMEÑA
President of the Philippines
By the President
Secretary to the President
